summary: Turn public priorities into delivery roadmaps, service measures and accountable action. Explore the five-day public leadership course.
lede: Public-service leadership development helps leaders translate policy priorities into accountable service delivery. It is for current and aspiring public-sector managers, policy leaders and directors who set goals, coordinate teams and explain decisions amid competing demands and limited capacity. Participants practise building delivery roadmaps and service dashboards, preparing decision papers, mapping stakeholders, assessing risks and communicating progress while working with incomplete information.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for current and aspiring public-sector leaders who translate policy direction into service outcomes, lead teams and account for delivery. It suits professionals with some management or policy exposure who want stronger, practical methods for performance review, cross-organisational coordination and change implementation.
prerequisites: Experience or current responsibility in public-sector management, policy, programme delivery or service leadership is expected. No coding or programming is required.
